resume-r1.goal: Create src/store.js exporting a class Store with a set(key, value) method that stores values in an internal Map. Do NOT implement get() yet and do NOT commit anything.

resume-r2.goal: Continue the previous round: add get(key) to the Store class in src/store.js (returns the stored value or undefined), create test/store.test.mjs covering set+get with node:test, make the tests pass, and commit.
